canonical_definition: General Language Understanding refers to the breadth and depth of language knowledge and competence across diverse subjects and tasks, encompassing semantic comprehension, reasoning, and linguistic abilities. It is commonly assessed through multi-task evaluations such as MMLU, CEval, or GLUE benchmarks, with some definitions emphasizing academic/professional testing frameworks, others highlighting core language understanding in decoder-only LLMs, and varying focus on commonsense reasoning or task-specific metrics.
